title: Ryan NYP Spirit of St. Louis (Microsoft)
sources: Cockpit input events enumerated from MSFS 11.0.282174.999 (SimConnect EnumerateInputEvents)
Microsoft_Spirit_of_StLouis/Checklist/Spirit_Of_St_Louis_Checklist.xml and NYP_Lib.xml shipped with the aircraft (the sim's interactive checklist: events with parameters, tested variables)
Microsoft_Spirit_of_StLouis/model.1928/Interior_SpiritOfStLouis_1928.xml (the cockpit model: which control is which, the K: events and L: variables behind them)
Official/Steam/microsoft-aircraft-spirit-of-st-louis/en-US.locPak (the aircraft's English tooltips) and Official/Steam/fs-base/en-US.locPak (the checklist texts)

entries.name: DEICE_Engine_1
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the lever DEICE_Lever_CarburatorRamAir (ASOBO_DEICE_Lever_Engine_Template). Not tried.

entries.name: ENGINE_Magneto_1
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the switch template numbers the positions 0 BOTH, 1 LEFT, 2 RIGHT, 3 OFF. Not tried: which of them this event takes is not confirmed.

entries.name: MAGNETO1_LEFT
entries.note: A standard event; the checklist only uses BOTH and OFF. Not tried.

entries.name: MAGNETO1_RIGHT
entries.note: A standard event; the checklist only uses BOTH and OFF. Not tried.

entries.name: MAGNETO_BOTH
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: MAGNETO_BOTH, then it tests RECIP ENG LEFT MAGNETO:1 and RIGHT MAGNETO:1. Not tried through this program.

entries.name: MAGNETO1_OFF
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: MAGNETO1_OFF at shutdown. Not tried through this program.

entries.name: MIXTURE1_SET
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: MIXTURE1_SET 16383 is rich (the checklist tests GENERAL ENG MIXTURE LEVER POSITION at 100 %) and 0 is lean (cut off). Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUEL_Mixture_1
entries.note: Not tried; the range this event takes is not known. The sim's own checklist uses the K: event MIXTURE1_SET, 0 to 16383, listed in this panel.

entries.name: MIXTURE1_SET
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: 0 is lean. Not tried through this program.

entries.name: MIXTURE1_SET
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: 16383 is rich. Not tried through this program.

entries.name: ENGINE_Primer_1_Lever
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the primer lever (ASOBO_ENGINE_Lever_Primer_Template). Not tried: how the event moves it is not known; the checklist strokes it with the K: event TOGGLE_PRIMER.

entries.name: ENGINE_Primer_1_Lever_Lock
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the lock of the primer lever. Not tried.

entries.name: TOGGLE_PRIMER
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: TOGGLE_PRIMER, repeated until three strokes are counted (RECIP ENG PRIMER:1). Not tried through this program.

entries.name: TOGGLE_STARTER1
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the hand prop (NYP_Paper_Start, tooltip "Hand prop the airplane") sends (>K:TOGGLE_STARTER1), and the checklist sends the same event. Not tried through this program.

entries.name: THROTTLE1_SET
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: THROTTLE1_SET 0 closes the throttle and 16383 opens it fully (the checklist tests GENERAL ENG THROTTLE LEVER POSITION at 0 and 100 %). Not tried through this program.

entries.name: ENGINE_Throttle_1
entries.note: Not tried; the range this event takes is not known (a fraction 0 to 1 on the F/A-18E). The sim's own checklist uses the K: event THROTTLE1_SET, 0 to 16383, listed in this panel.

entries.name: THROTTLE1_SET
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: 0 closes the throttle. Not tried through this program.

entries.name: THROTTLE1_SET
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: 16383 opens the throttle fully. Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUEL_Valve_2
entries.note: From the cockpit model: valve 2, its tooltip is "Center Wing Fuel tank valve". Not tried: the checklist opens it with the K: event FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 2.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE 2, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:2. Its tooltip is "Center Wing Fuel tank valve". Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 2, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:2. Its tooltip is "Center Wing Fuel tank valve". Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUEL_Valve_6
entries.note: From the cockpit model: valve 6, its tooltip is "Engine inlet valve" and the checklist calls it the global valve. Not tried: the checklist opens it with the K: event FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 6.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE 6, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:6. Its tooltip is "Engine inlet valve" and the checklist calls it the global valve. Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 6, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:6. Its tooltip is "Engine inlet valve" and the checklist calls it the global valve. Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUEL_Valve_1
entries.note: From the cockpit model: valve 1, its tooltip is "Left wing fuel tank valve". Not tried: the checklist opens it with the K: event FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 1.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE 1, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:1. Its tooltip is "Left wing fuel tank valve". Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 1, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:1. Its tooltip is "Left wing fuel tank valve". Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUEL_Valve_3
entries.note: From the cockpit model: valve 3, its tooltip is "Right Wing Fuel tank valve". Not tried: the checklist opens it with the K: event FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 3.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE 3, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:3. Its tooltip is "Right Wing Fuel tank valve". Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 3, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:3. Its tooltip is "Right Wing Fuel tank valve". Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUEL_Valve_4
entries.note: From the cockpit model: valve 4, the cockpit gives it only the generic tooltip "fuel switch open / closed". Not tried: the checklist opens it with the K: event FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 4.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE 4, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:4. The cockpit gives it only the generic tooltip "fuel switch open / closed". Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 4, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:4. The cockpit gives it only the generic tooltip "fuel switch open / closed". Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUEL_Valve_5
entries.note: From the cockpit model: valve 5, the cockpit gives it only the generic tooltip "fuel switch open / closed". Not tried: the checklist opens it with the K: event FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 5.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_CLOSE 5, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:5. The cockpit gives it only the generic tooltip "fuel switch open / closed". Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN
entries.note: The sim's own checklist uses it: FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN 5, then it tests FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH:5. The cockpit gives it only the generic tooltip "fuel switch open / closed". Not tried through this program.

entries.name: FUEL_Manual_Pump_2
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the wobble pump (ASOBO_FUEL_Lever_Pump_Template, ID 2). Not tried; the checklist has its manual pump step commented out.

entries.name: PARKING_BRAKES
entries.note: A standard event that toggles the parking brake (the checklist uses PARKING_BRAKE_SET). Not tried.

entries.name: LANDING_GEAR_ParkingBrake
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the parking brake lever NYP_Parking_Brake. Not tried; the checklist sets it with the K: event PARKING_BRAKE_SET.

entries.name: TOGGLE_AIRCRAFT_EXIT
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the door handle sends 0 (>K:TOGGLE_AIRCRAFT_EXIT), only below 10 knots. Not tried.

entries.name: HANDLING_ElevatorTrim_1
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the trim wheel (ASOBO_HANDLING_Wheel_ElevatorTrim_Template). Not tried.

entries.name: INSTRUMENT_Altimeter_1
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the altimeter knob; the strip reads 29.0 to 32.5 inHg and the knob 29.5 to 32.0. Not tried: the unit the event takes (hPa on the F/A-18E) is not known.

entries.name: INSTRUMENT_Clock_Time
entries.note: The clock of the panel (ASOBO_INSTRUMENT_Needle_Current_Time_Clock_Template). Not tried.

entries.name: INSTRUMENT_Clock_Ajustment_Target
entries.note: The clock setting knob. Not tried.

entries.name: INDUCTOR_COMPASS_REF_DEC
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the inductor compass knob (INDUCTOR_COMPASS_REF_DEC anticlockwise). Not tried.

entries.name: INDUCTOR_COMPASS_REF_INC
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the inductor compass knob (INDUCTOR_COMPASS_REF_INC clockwise). Not tried.

entries.name: LIGHTING_PANEL_1
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the panel light dimmer (ASOBO_LIGHTING_Knob_Panel_Template, potentiometer 3). Not tried; on the CJ4 the panel light event misbehaves.

entries.name: NYP_Periscope_anim_handle_percent
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the periscope lever drags the L: variable NYP_Periscope_anim_handle_percent in percent (0 to 100). Not tried.

entries.name: XMLVAR_YokeHidden1
entries.note: From the cockpit model: the stick's hit box flips the L: variable XMLVAR_YokeHidden1 (cosmetic). Not tried.
